evals.name: gold-signal-extraction
evals.prompt: Run the signal extractor skill to extract trading signals from my Telegram channels. I've configured it with my Telegram credentials in ~/.claude/quantflow_config.json. The skill should scan all channels, extract any BUY/SELL signals for GOLD with ENTRY, SL, and TP prices, deduplicate them over the 24-hour window, and output JSON to the signal validator.
evals.expected_output: Extracted signals in JSONL format to ~/.claude/quantflow_extracted_signals.jsonl with proper deduplication state saved to ~/.claude/quantflow_extractor_state.json

assertions.name: state_file_created
assertions.description: State file is created and contains channels, last_message_ids, and seen_signal_hashes

assertions.name: jsonl_output_created
assertions.description: JSONL output file is created with at least one extracted signal (or gracefully handles no signals)

assertions.name: signal_structure_valid
assertions.description: Each extracted signal contains: signal_id, source, extracted_signal (with action, instrument, entry, sl, tp), quality metrics

assertions.name: deduplication_works
assertions.description: Duplicate signals within 24h window are marked with is_duplicate=true

assertions.name: no_crashes
assertions.description: Skill completes without errors or crashes, handles missing config gracefully

evals.name: resumable-execution
evals.prompt: Test the signal extractor's ability to resume from where it left off. First execution: run the extractor and verify it creates state file with last_message_ids. Second execution: run again immediately and verify it only processes NEW messages since the first run (not all historical messages). Check that the state file is properly updated with new message IDs.
evals.expected_output: State file updated with new message IDs, second execution processes only messages newer than what was processed in the first execution

assertions.name: state_persistence
assertions.description: State file persists between executions with correct channel_ids and last_message_ids

assertions.name: incremental_processing
assertions.description: Second run only processes new messages, not re-processing old ones

assertions.name: no_duplicate_extraction
assertions.description: Same signal is not extracted twice if run consecutively

evals.name: multi-instrument-signals
evals.prompt: Configure the extractor to monitor for multiple instruments: GOLD, BTC, EURUSD, and GBPUSD. Run the extractor and verify it correctly extracts and categorizes signals for all these instruments. Check that signals are properly labeled by instrument type and can be filtered by instrument in downstream processing.
evals.expected_output: Extracted signals properly labeled with correct instruments, examples: BUY GOLD, SELL BTCUSD, BUY EURUSD in the output JSONL

assertions.name: multi_instrument_support
assertions.description: Signals for GOLD, BTC, EURUSD, GBPUSD are all correctly identified and labeled

assertions.name: instrument_parsing
assertions.description: Instrument field correctly populated for different signal formats
